_comment: Per-Article native-unit manifest for build/build-standalone.sh. Only Articles with native-Typst units need UNITS; any article with an empty units list (4-9) renders as pure markdown in a single pandoc pass. Per unit: typ (native file under source/), splice (after-prose | at-marker:<NAME>), data (--input data= value), conditional_on (path under source/ that must exist or the unit is skipped), parity (pad-to-odd-before = pad a blank so the unit's first page lands on a verso, e.g. Art-2 D1), pad_to (even-block = pad a trailing blank to keep an even block; only relevant mid-document, a no-op when the unit is last).
_ownership_comment: data_sources declares which files carry an Article's binding content, for the substantive-change determination. Each entry is {path, compare}: json-keyed (keyed leaf diff; carries key, and substantive_fields when only SOME fields are substantive -- when substantive_fields is ABSENT every leaf is substantive), binary-hash (report 'changed (binary)' and require a recorded human call), or generated-from (carries from; counts only through that file, and a change with an unchanged source is an ANOMALY). A path ending in / claims every tracked file beneath it. PROSE IS NOT DECLARED HERE: ownership of an Article's prose is the article-0N-*.md convention, which is also build-standalone.sh's fallback, and declaring it would change manifest.py prose's output for Articles 4-9.

data_sources._key_note: the file is a bare LIST of 13 district objects, keyed by code
data_sources._excluded_note: group, color and band_text are presentation: they change what the spread looks like, not what is permitted

data_sources._key_note: an object keyed by Type code (S1..R5) plus a _meta block; no substantive_fields, because every field of a Type entry is printed Code -- code, family, name, context, description, purpose, note, row, edges, segments, standards, applies_in, attributes

data_sources._excluded_note: D7: districts, maindot, nonconformity, present_use, addresses and geometry are DERIVED. Address counts changed on all 214 segments between v0.22 and v0.24; without this partition every GIS refresh reads as an amendment to Article 3
